main_text.p: tinebit alioqui quod in Pelagianis damnauit Innocentius, Quid mihi nunc opus est Deo ? Ais, Dedit mihi Deus quo iustus sim : & hoc quidem pulchrum videtur gratiae diuinae elogium, primulumq; inscitis auribus allubescit ; quod tamen sub specie pietatis, Christum spoliat. Quin ais, Dedit quo me redimam : Eodem enim quo iustificamur, redimimur ; (iustificati eius sanguine) ecce iustificat nos qui & redemit sanguis Innoc.patr. Milevit.Rom.5.9.{Greek}Perge vero : Dedit hoc Deus ; Nunquid sine te? Istane vt sine interuentu, sine operatione Liberi Arbitrij

page.notes: The Greek word after "sanguis" (σταυρωθέντος-type word, printed in Greek letters, partly blurred) is illegible in detail; the Greek word is set beside "sanguis" and is only approximately read. Right-margin notes: "Innoc.patr." and "Milevit." (one note), "Rom.5.9.". A brown stain covers part of "operatione". Faint show-through from the reverse page appears in the margins and is omitted.
